title: DCERPC: Add dissector for IWbemLoginClientIDEx(9f6c78ef-fce5-42fa-abea-3e7df91921dc) Interface
description:
DCERPC: Add dissector for IWbemLoginClientIDEx(9f6c78ef-fce5-42fa-abea-3e7df91921dc) Interface

Its not a documented interface from Microsoft. We have some useful information in this blog about this interface.
https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/effective-parenting-detecting-lrpc-based-parent-pid-spoofing

Ref: CWbemLevel1Login::SetClientInfoEx in wbemcore.dll
